# WHAT THIS IS: a change detector, not an aspiration. Every row was chosen by
# INTENT first ("an agent wants the money invariant"), then the actual ranking
# was measured and the mode set to whatever currently holds. That means a green
# file proves nothing improved by accident — but a red row proves something
# regressed. Editing synonyms.tsv or the scoring weights without re-running this
# Anchors are TEXT, never positional (`#5`): a positional ref shifts the moment
# a heading is inserted, which would be a false failure.
#   top   — expected ref must be hit #1
#   topN  — expected ref must appear in the top 8
# If you tighten the ranking and a `topN` row starts winning outright, promote
# it to `top` so the improvement is locked in.
